title: Retain unresolved JD content without repeated extraction
summary: If interpretation is incomplete or invalid, retain the original passage and mark it unresolved in the brief.
body: If interpretation is incomplete or invalid, retain the original passage and mark it unresolved in the brief. Do not spend repeated drafts perfecting extraction before writing. Original passage retention does not prove coverage; a compound requirement stays unresolved until its meaningful parts are accounted for.
